publisher: South Dakota Department of Social Services

official_sources.evidence: The public search covers registered family day care, licensed child or school-age programs, and informal or in-home providers with name, program ID, city, ZIP, county, openings, accreditation, operating-month, and age filters.
DSS provides provider search context and up to three years of monitoring reports for regulated programs.
The publisher distinguishes informal or in-home care, registered family day care, licensed child care, and school-age programs.
DSS publishes historical aggregate data and warns that family home providers may choose not to register and therefore may be omitted.

scope.warning: Licensed, registered, informal or in-home, inspection-visible, and currently operating are separate assertions; voluntary registration prevents a complete family-home denominator.

temporal.limitation: The search can filter an operational status, but the discovery does not establish a dated complete release, continuous operation, or completeness across voluntary and informal cohorts.

next_action: Validate the public search response contract without retaining provider rows; keep licensed, registered, school-age, and informal or in-home cohorts separate and document voluntary-registration, privacy, temporal, pagination, and row-conservation boundaries before any connector decision.
